name: Crow Style
detailed_description:
Crow Style is a pixelated stealth side-scroller where you play as an egocentric crow with one goal: to ruin a prestigious fashion contest. Sneak into your rivals' homes and destroy their creations! But to achieve your objective, you’ll need to master the pinnacle of stealth: the art of disguise.

Features

  • Sneak into rival designers’ homes,

Multiple environments to infiltrate and explore. -Use disguises and hide. Wear different skins to confuse and avoid your enemies.

  • Ruin your rivals’ clothes without being seen,

To complete your mission, leave the outfits in true Crow Style!

  • Uncover the contestants’ secrets and escape before you’re caught!

Read letters scattered around the levels to find the best ways to sabotage your enemies.


Story In a city where fashion is more than just art — it's power, influence, and prestige — there’s a contest capable of turning designers into living legends. And you, of course, won’t miss this chance.

You are Edgar, an egocentric, snobbish crow absolutely obsessed with social status. For you, winning is more than a matter of talent… it’s about eliminating the competition in style! the crow loves to play: silent sabotage, surgical alteration of every rival’s outfit, and a stylish strike pulled off with class in the shadows!

Each house is a world of its own, filled with eccentric designers and unique styles. Be very careful — being seen might not end well for your reputation! After all, in the fashion world, the worst crime is getting caught red-handed.

Highlights

  • Charming pixel art visuals,

  • Sharp humor,

  • Strategic stealth-based gameplay,

  • Dark and unique atmosphere
